headline: Nasdaq Volatile as Democratic Midterm Wins Highlight Data Center Pushback
summary: Nasdaq dropped as much as 2.4% following Democratic midterm election victories before recovering, while healthcare and solar energy stocks surged in New York amid growing political opposition to data centers.
why: US midterm elections impact regulatory expectations for tech infrastructure, clean energy, and healthcare sectors, driving sharp sector rotations in US equity markets.
why_moved: Democratic midterm wins and local opposition to data-centre projects drove initial tech sell-offs before broader market buying recovered losses.
